title: 1155 Angel Number Meaning: Bold Change, Love & Twin Flame
desc: What does 1155 mean? In numerology, 1155 is read as: start something that changes everything. Meaning for love, career, twin flames and what to do when you se
lead: 1155 pairs two 1s (new beginnings) with two 5s (change). It is read as a bold new start that brings real change. Its root is 3 (1+1+5+5 = 12, 1+2 = 3).
sections: The 1s are initiative and the 5s are freedom and movement. Numerologists read 1155 as a sign to stop waiting and make a change. The root of 3 adds optimism and voice.

1155 can show up as 11:55 on any clock, so it is easy to meet more than once in a day.

Part of the reason is simple attention: once a number catches your eye, your brain flags it every time. Numerologists use that moment as a prompt. Notice your thought when the number appears.

If you are single: 1155 favours trying a new approach to meeting people.

If you are in a relationship: 1155 points to a big positive change in the relationship, such as a move or new plan.
Twin flame readers link 1155 to a breakthrough in the connection. Treat it as a prompt for reflection, not a promise about how a connection will turn out.
What does 1155 mean for money and career?
1155 suits career moves, relocations and new ventures.
How is 1155 related to other angel numbers?

• 1111 is the pure form of the digit 1 in this number, so reading it helps you understand the new beginnings and independence side of 1155.
  • 5555 is the pure form of the digit 5 in this number, so reading it helps you understand the change and freedom side of 1155.
  • 333 carries the energy of this number's root, 3, on its own.
